key_idea: Count how much was added in all, then take away the numbers you can see.
steps: The L-shape is 3 squares tall and 2 squares wide. On the grid it can start in 2 rows and 3 columns, so it fits in 2 x 3 = 6 places.
Each time it adds 1 to 4 cells, so all the numbers add up to 6 x 4 = 24.
Add the numbers you can see, row by row: 3 + 6 + 3 + 4 = 16.

choice_feedback.A: All the numbers add up to 24, and the ones you see add up to 16. 24 - 16 = 8.
